cases.name: Legacy Bare Script Service
cases.precalculated_policy_yaml:
# Zero-Trust AI Agent Policy Contract
version: '1.0'
permission_tier: sandbox_write
enforcement: strict
protected_paths:
  - .agent-policy.yaml
  - .env
  - infra/prod/
allowed_tools:
  - file_read
  - file_edit
  - run_command
command_rules:
  banned:
    - 'rm -rf*'
    - '*curl*|*sh*'
    - 'git push --force*'
verification_hooks:
  pre_commit_gate: 'pytest -v --tb=short tests/'
cases.precalculated_agents_md:
# Agent Operating Guidelines & Harness Engineering Contract

> **First Principles:** Models are stochastic token predictors. Without an execution harness, agents suffer from context drift and undetected regressions. All actions here are bounded and test-gated.

## 1. Architectural & Design Anchor Points
- [ARCHITECTURE.md](ARCHITECTURE.md): System boundaries and topology

## 2. Multi-Tier Verification Ladder
1. Tier 1 (Unit Loop): Fast sub-second test execution (`pytest -k <func>`, budget < 0.2s)
2. Tier 2 (Static Checks): `ruff check` linting and `mypy --strict` type verification
3. Tier 3 (Full Regression Gate): `pytest -v --tb=short tests/` (100% green required)
4. Tier 4 (CI Telemetry): `pytest --junitxml=.agent/results.xml`

## 3. Environment & Boundaries
- Detected Stack: general
- Permission Tier: `sandbox_write` (scoped strictly to `src/` and `tests/`)
- Quarantined Paths (Read-Only): .agent-policy.yaml, .env, infra/prod/
- Invariant: Never mark task complete or push commits if any test fails.
